description: The shop as a business sees it: the order funnel from creation to notification, revenue, payment and reservation success, end-to-end order completion time and dead-lettered records. Correlate dips with the orange chaos markers.

panels.description: Orders created per minute by the generator and accepted by Kafka. The heartbeat of the shop: compare with the target rate on Service & Client Runtime.
panels.title: Orders / min

panels.description: Value of shipped orders per minute (lab_revenue_cents_total).
panels.title: Revenue / min

panels.description: Revenue rate of the last 15 minutes divided by the same window one hour earlier. Below 80 % for a while fires LabRevenueDrop.
panels.title: Revenue vs 1 h ago

panels.description: Completed ÷ all payments, last 5 minutes. The simulated payment provider fails some payments on purpose; chaos can make it worse.
panels.title: Payment success

panels.description: Created minus shipped minus cancelled orders (counters since service start): orders still being processed somewhere.
panels.title: Orders in flight

panels.description: 95th percentile time from order creation to shipped/cancelled.
panels.title: Completion p95

panels.description: How many orders reached each step within the time range: created → paid → stock reserved → shipped, plus cancelled and notifications sent. Big drops between steps show where orders get stuck or fail.
panels.title: Funnel (selected time range)

panels.description: Throughput of each funnel step per minute. In a healthy shop the lines run in parallel with a small delay; a step that falls behind is the bottleneck (check its service on Service & Client Runtime).
panels.title: Funnel steps per minute

panels.description: Value of shipped orders per minute, stacked by region, and the total one hour earlier (dashed) for comparison.
panels.title: Revenue per minute by region

panels.description: Completed and failed payments per minute; failures broken down by reason. A jump in one reason after a chaos experiment shows what the experiment did.
panels.title: Payments by result

panels.description: Reserved vs rejected stock reservations per minute (rejected = out of stock or invalid), and releases after cancellations.
panels.title: Stock reservations

panels.description: Refunds per minute and refunded value. Refunds happen when an order is cancelled after its payment completed.
panels.title: Refunds

panels.description: Time from order creation to shipped or cancelled as a heatmap of VictoriaMetrics histogram buckets (vmrange, converted with prometheus_buckets, top 20 buckets). Healthy: one tight band of a few seconds. A second band higher up = some orders take a slow path (retries, lag).
panels.title: Order completion time distribution

panels.description: Order completion percentiles per outcome (shipped vs cancelled), MetricsQL histogram_quantile on vmrange buckets.
panels.title: Completion p50 / p95 / p99 by outcome

panels.description: Records the services gave up on and wrote to a dead-letter topic, by source topic and by reason. Poison messages from the generator end up here by design; anything else is a bug or a chaos effect.
panels.title: Dead-lettered records

panels.description: Duplicate events the idempotent consumers recognised and skipped (generator sends some on purpose; retries after rebalances add more).
panels.title: Duplicates detected

panels.description: Notifications sent per minute by channel. If shipped/cancelled orders keep coming but notifications fall behind, the notification service is lagging (LabNotificationBacklog).
panels.title: Notifications per channel

panels.description: Units in stock for the 20 most popular SKUs (inventory service). Low stock leads to rejected reservations.
panels.title: Stock of the top SKUs

title: Kafka Lab · Commerce Business
